notes.title: Updated June 7, 2021
notes.content:
Adventure mode:

- Improved camera management. 
   - Improvement of the field of view "FOV".
   - Improvement of the collision which manages the change of camera.
   - Deactivation of the motion blur.
   - Improvement of the camera movements.

- Graphic optimization.
- Fixed a bug related to the Steam achievement (Chapter 1: Chicken).
- Improved NPC AI.

Story mode and general interface:

- Fixed a bug related to buttons that did not engage from time to time on proposals.
